crossroads.kicker: Story Crossroads • Cross-Book Continuity With Luna & Leo
crossroads.title: Dinner at Delores's Apartment: Which Luna & Leo Story Path Are You Arriving From?
crossroads.prompt: Delores is the exact same Delores from Luna & Leo—where her relationship with Leo Porter reached a Crossroads during the October 2003 Columbus Day Sibling Weekend. Choose which upstream history Delores and her mother Robyn carry into tonight's dinner and the rest of Jack & Sarah. Both paths forward are complete, coequal continuations through the end of the novel.

options.label: Arriving From: Luna Screamed 'GET OUT!' During Sibling Weekend
options.subtitle: Delores never took Leo to Washington state and owes zero court restitution—instead, Robyn is livid Delores blew her golden meal ticket with the wealthy Porters, and Delores is obsessed with beating family guardianship before another 'precious sister' throws her out.
forbidden_terms: screaming phone calls from her sister

options.label: Arriving From: The Four-Day Pathfinder Trip to Washington & Court Restitution
options.subtitle: Delores returned in disgrace from Kent, Washington owing massive court-ordered restitution to the Porter family—driving Robyn to eye Jermaine as a financial bailout while Delores hunts for a replacement target.
